findings.title: Imported feed content is cooked as raw HTML without sanitization
findings.description: `Post#cook` returns `raw` unchanged for `raw_html` posts. That skips the cooking pipeline and the `after_post_cook` filters. The only producer is `PollFeed`, which passes `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` straight into `TopicEmbed.import` (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:35-36). `CGI.unescapeHTML` is a decode, not a sanitizer. If SimpleRSS already decoded entities, this is a second decode that turns literal `<` text into tags. The stored HTML is rendered unescaped in the topic view (app/assets/javascripts/discourse/templates/post.js.handlebars:70, `{{{cooked}}}`) and on the embed page (app/views/embed/best.html.erb:19, `raw post.cooked`). Script or event-handler markup in a feed item, or in a compromised feed, runs on the forum origin. Fix: sanitize with an allow-list before storage, and do not use raw-HTML cooking for anything the importer has not sanitized.

findings.title: URL is interpolated into HTML without escaping
findings.description: `"#{url}"` is built without escaping, and the only check is the regex at line 11. A single quote is a legal RFC 3986 sub-delimiter, so it should survive `URI()` in `absolutize_urls` (line 57). It can close the `href` attribute and inject an attribute that persists into `cooked`. Feed links reach this line directly (poll_feed.rb:32-36). Anonymous `embed_url` values reach it through EmbedController and TopicRetriever, which checks only the host (topic_retriever.rb:14-15). That path also needs the embeddable host to return 200 for the crafted path. I did not run this payload and did not verify whether libxml2 keeps the injected attribute. Related: `contents <<` (line 13) mutates the caller's string, and `^https?` (line 11) should be `\A`, because `^` matches at any line start. The newline case is not currently exploitable, because `URI()` rejects newlines. Fix: escape the URL, for example with `ERB::Util.html_escape`, or build the anchor with Nokogiri.

findings.title: Embed view has an invalid ERB statement
findings.description: `<%- end if %>` is not valid Ruby. The `end` closes the `if`, and the trailing modifier `if` has no condition. Every request for an existing embed topic should raise a template SyntaxError (inferred from the grammar; I did not render the template). The suite cannot catch it. spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb has no `render_views`, and it stubs `TopicView.new` to return nil. Fix: `<%- end %>`.

findings.title: Embed assets are missing from the production precompile list
findings.description: `embed.css` (app/views/layouts/embed.html.erb:4) and `embed.js` are not in `config.assets.precompile`. Production sets `config.assets.compile = false` (config/environments/production.rb:23) and `serve_static_assets = false` (line 13). The embed page loads without its stylesheet, and the host page's `embed.js` request returns 404, so the feature does not work in production. Fix: add `'embed.css'` and `'embed.js'` to the list. Inferred from config; I did not run `assets:precompile`.

findings.title: One bad feed item aborts the whole poll, and the import check races
findings.description: The loop has no per-item rescue, and the job is `retry: false` (line 12). One item that raises stops every later item in that run. The next hourly run hits the same item and fails again, so later items never import, and nothing is logged. The check-then-insert in `TopicEmbed.import` (app/models/topic_embed.rb:15-20) also races with `RetrieveTopic` and the poll. Both can pass the `blank?` check, and one then fails on the unique index for `embed_url` (db/migrate/20131217174004_create_topic_embeds.rb:11). Fix: rescue and log per item, and handle `RecordNotUnique` on insert.

findings.title: Failed post creation is not detected
findings.description: `PostCreator#create` returns `@post` even when the save failed. `save_post` raises `Rollback` (lib/post_creator.rb:231-235), the `Post.transaction` block swallows it, and `create` still returns the unsaved post (line 86). `post.present?` is therefore true for a failed post. `TopicEmbed.create!` then runs with a nil `post.id` and violates `post_id null: false` (db/migrate/20131217174004_create_topic_embeds.rb:5). Fix: check `post.persisted?` or `post.errors` before creating the mapping.

findings.title: Throttle is keyed on the full URL, so anonymous requests can bypass it
findings.description: Each unique URL variant, for example `?n=1`, `?n=2`, gets its own 60-second window. Anonymous requests pass `user_id: nil` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:15), so no exemption applies, and nothing limits requests per IP or globally. For each new variant, an anonymous request enqueues a job, runs a full feed poll when feed polling is on (topic_retriever.rb:40-41), GETs the page (line 52), and creates a topic as the `embed_by_username` user. Separately, `setnx` followed by `expire` (lines 27-28) is not atomic. If the process dies between them, the key never expires and that URL is blocked for non-staff permanently. Fix: throttle per normalized URL and per host or globally, rate-limit the endpoint, and set the key with a single `SET key 1 NX EX 60`.

findings.title: Host guard passes host-less input to `open`, and remote fetches have no timeout or size cap
findings.description: `SiteSetting.embeddable_host != URI(@embed_url).host` evaluates to false when both sides are nil. If the setting were nil and the input had no host, such as `/etc/passwd`, retrieval would proceed to `open(url)` (app/models/topic_embed.rb:48), and Kernel#open would read a local file. Production settings default to `''`, and the controller rejects a blank host (embed_controller.rb:25), so this is defense in depth rather than a live hole. The spec for the nil case (spec/components/topic_retriever_spec.rb:9-12) passes only because its URL has a host. The `open` calls also have no timeout or size limit (topic_embed.rb:48, app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:29), and open-uri follows redirects. Fix: require a present `http(s)` URI before fetching, and fetch with `URI.parse(url).open`, timeouts, and a size cap.

findings.title: Protocol-relative URLs are rewritten to the wrong host
findings.description: `//cdn.example.com/x.png` becomes `http://<forum-host>/cdn.example.com/x.png`. The `start_with?('/')` checks (lines 64 and 70) match protocol-relative URLs, and `sub(/^\/+/, '')` (lines 65 and 71) then strips the leading slashes. No spec covers this. Fix: leave `//`-prefixed values alone or expand them with the source scheme.

findings.title: Origin check in the embed script is a substring test
findings.description: `discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1` accepts any origin that is a prefix of the forum URL. For example, `https://forum.example.co` passes for `https://forum.example.com/`. The handler only sets the iframe height, so the impact is low, but the check is wrong. Fix: compare parsed origins for equality, and check `e.source === iframe.contentWindow`.

findings.title: Deleted topics permanently 404 their embed
findings.description: `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed` returns the id of a trashed topic (app/models/topic_embed.rb:78-80). `Trashable` hides trashed rows from the default scope (lib/trashable.rb:5), so `TopicView.new` raises `NotFound` (lib/topic_view.rb:300). The mapping row still exists, so the URL 404s forever and is never re-imported. Fix: treat a trashed or missing topic as no mapping, and clear or re-point the `TopicEmbed` row when a topic is destroyed.

findings.title: Disqus importer has regressions
findings.description: (1) `created_at: Date.parse(t[:created_at])` was dropped, so imported topics are dated the day of import. (2) `import_remote` now does an HTTP GET per thread with no rescue. One 404 aborts the whole run, and the `ensure` at line 182 only restores settings. (3) The `category` option was removed without deprecation, so callers passing `-c` lose that setting. Threads with non-http links are also skipped silently, because `import` returns nil (topic_embed.rb:11). Fix: pass `created_at` through, rescue and log per thread, and deprecate `--category` explicitly.

findings.title: Gemfile.lock is not updated for the new gems
findings.description: `Gemfile` adds `ruby-readability` and `simple-rss`, but `Gemfile.lock` has no entries for either. Only `Gemfile_rails4.lock` was updated. Deployment installs with a frozen or deployment lock will fail or re-resolve. The lock file is outside the diff you gave me, so I checked it on disk. Fix: regenerate `Gemfile.lock`.

findings.title: Migrations use `force: true`, and a shipped migration was edited
findings.description: `force: true` drops an existing table before creating it. Re-running this migration, or a redo, on a database with data drops that data. For `topic_embeds`, losing the mapping means re-importing creates duplicate topics. The `force: true` added to the already-shipped `create_top_topics` migration (db/migrate/20131223171005_create_top_topics.rb:3) has the same problem, and it changes history: databases that already ran it will not get the change. Fix: remove `force: true`. If a guard is needed, use `table_exists?` in a new migration. If there was a specific reason for the top_topics edit, state it in the PR.

findings.title: Adding `cook_method` to `posts` can lock the table
findings.description: `add_column :posts, :cook_method, :integer, default: 1, null: false` on a large table rewrites the table under an exclusive lock on PostgreSQL before 11. That can take a big forum's posts table offline while it runs. The default of 1 does match `Post.cook_methods[:regular]` (lib/enum.rb:14 starts at 1). Fix: add the nullable column, backfill in batches, then set the default and `NOT NULL`.

findings.title: Tests miss the failure paths and assert the wrong thing
findings.description: The test named "is 404 without an embed_url" asserts only `should_not be_success`, so its name is wrong. No spec renders views, so the template error above goes uncaught. `TopicRetriever` specs stub private methods (`expects(:perform_retrieve)`, `expects(:retrieved_recently?)`), and nothing covers `perform_retrieve`, `fetch_http`, or the throttle. `poll_feed_spec.rb` tests only the gating conditions, not item import or failure. `topic_embed_spec.rb` has no tests for URL escaping, protocol-relative links, or failed creation.

findings.title: Embed layout interpolates `request.referer` into a script string
findings.description: `'<%= request.referer %>'` sits inside a `<script>` block. HTML escaping blocks quote breakout here, since `'` is never decoded in a script block. That works by accident of the escaping rather than by design. Use `j` (`escape_javascript`). `postMessage` also takes an origin, not a full referer URL.

findings.title: Embed headers and gate are questionable
findings.description: `X-Frame-Options: ALLOWALL` (line 28) is not a defined value. Framing is allowed only because the header is ignored. Use an explicit policy, such as CSP `frame-ancestors`. The Referer check (line 26) is not access control, because any client can send that header. It is acceptable as a framing gate, but it should not be relied on to protect content.

findings.title: Dead code and unrelated changes
findings.description: `feed_key` (lines 20-22) is never called. The `require_dependency 'email/sender'` in app/jobs/regular/retrieve_topic.rb:1 is unused. spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb:2 requires a file it does not use. db/migrate/20131210181901_migrate_word_counts.rb:3 is a whitespace-only change to an unrelated migration, and lib/post_revisor.rb:13-14 removes a blank line. Trim these from the PR or explain them.

findings.title: `cook_method` cannot be set through the HTTP API
findings.description: `PostCreator.new(current_user, params)` (line 35) receives the output of `create_params`, which calls `params.permit(...)` on an explicit list that excludes `cook_method`. Users cannot choose raw-HTML cooking through `POST /posts`. The new `skip_validations` option in `PostRevisor` is also unreachable from `update`, which passes only `edit_reason` (line 84). The API-key path that allows `skip_validations` on create (lines 244-245) predates this diff.

findings.title: Job arguments, anonymous-only caching, and `scrub` on Ruby 2.0 check out
findings.description: `Jobs::Base#perform` applies `with_indifferent_access`, so `args[:embed_url]` in `RetrieveTopic` works after Sidekiq's JSON round trip. `discourse_expires_in` caches only for anonymous users (app/controllers/application_controller.rb:163-170), so per-user visibility is not shared through the cache. CI runs Ruby 2.0.0 (`.travis.yml`), and `String#scrub` is provided by lib/freedom_patches/scrub.rb.
